pcb_constraints.common_mode_choke: Optional for EMI; minimize series inductance to keep eye open

pad_constraints.shared_pad_modes: DSEL/SDA, BSEL/SCL, EDGE/HTPLG share I2C and configuration functions (mode chosen by ISEL pin).

sdc_floorplan_hints.PLL_placement: Close to IDCK input pads + TXC output pads; isolate from digital noise; use on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass caps for noise immunity.
sdc_floorplan_hints.TMDS_driver_placement: Adjacent to TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC output pads; minimize trace length to package balls; route diff pair tightly.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Encoder_per_channel_placement: Three independent 8→10b encoder slices, one per channel; share clock domain with serializer.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Serializer_placement: 10:1 shift register clocked by 10× PLL bit clock; tail latch close to driver.
sdc_floorplan_hints.I2C_target_placement: On the slow clock domain; near SCL/SDA pads.
sdc_floorplan_hints.Input_DATA_register: Register on chosen IDCK edge (per EDGE bit); de-skew programmable latch window per DK[3:1].
sdc_floorplan_hints.DE_generator_placement: Counter block clocked by IDCK; programmed via I2C registers DE_DLY/DE_CNT/DE_TOP/DE_LIN.

fields.notes: The TFP410 datasheet does not provide PDK constraints (it is a packaged chip). Board-level high-speed differential routing rules apply: 100 Ω differential impedance, tight intra-pair skew, controlled trace length to keep loss under spec at 1.65 Gbps per pair. TI SLLA414 application note (general high-speed differential PCB design guide) provides applicable guidance for TMDS routing. The TFP410 package (PowerPAD) requires solid thermal connection to the PCB ground plane for the 250 mA worst-case I_DD.
